title: Apple and Rosemary Fizz Recipe
ldKeywords: Apple and rosemary fizz, Apple fizz recipe, Discarded vodka recipes, Vodka fizz recipe, easy
ldIngredientsRaw: 4 apple cores, and peel from 2 apples
ldInstructionsRaw: For the syrup, place all ingredients into a small saucepan with 150ml water. Bring to the boil and cook for 5 minutes, then simmer rapidly for a further 5 minutes. Set aside off the heat for a further 5 minutes
Strain the syrup through a fine sieve or muslin and chill
To make the fizz, add ice cubes to four wine glasses then top each with 50ml of vodka, 25ml apple and rosemary syrup and 75ml of soda
